message.content:
This is a **My Tickets** screen (a tickets screen, not a metro booking screen), though it displays an active metro QR ticket.

**Title:** "My Tickets" with the subtitle "One QR for bus & metro travel" and a "Scan & Book" button.

**Main elements visible:**
- Tabs: "Active Ticket" (selected) and "History"
- An active ticket card labeled "CHENNAI METRO · QR TICKET" with a "VALID" badge
- Route: Government Estate → Meenambakkam
- Details: 1 passenger · ₹40 · Valid till Today, 9:45 PM
- A large QR code with ticket ID "MTX-8821-4402" and note "Issued 3:47 PM · Show at the gate scanner"
- A "Quick book" section with shortcuts: Bus, Metro (center), and Passes
- Bottom navigation: Home, Tickets (active), a central "Bus Ticket" button, Pass, Account
